programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Gironde is the largest and most powerful tidal current in Europe. When the Gironde flows into the Atlantic, it is 15 kilometers wide and in the rhythm of the tides, it brings the waters from the Pyrenees and the Massif Central into the ocean. This often pushes its waters far out into the Gironde at high tide.This creates a world of its own that has shaped everything uniquely and intensely for tens of thousands of years. The water surface of the river is so large that the evaporation has created its own microclimate, which is stable and, together with the brackish waters, has influenced flora and fauna on the right and left of the bank for a long time.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Dordogne consists of a visible and an invisible system of flowing water. Caves and basins under the earth's surface store the excess water and return it to the river when it is dry. A perfect management of a precious resource, not invented by humans, but by the complex nature itself. The result is an ever life-giving river.

Swarms of bees harvest the honey from the city's almost half a million trees, while badgers can be found scurrying across courtyards and praying mantises await their prey in strips of railway land. The metropolis of Berlin is an urban jungle, providing a habitat for thousands of racoons, foxes, bats, squirrels, hedgehogs and beavers - Berlin is wild in more ways than one.

Kieling ventures to western China almost as far as the border with Tibet in search of the great panda, the legendary bamboo bear. Set against a gigantic natural backdrop, the filmmaker is attempting to track down the extremely reclusive creature. But finding one of the approximately 3000 pandas who live in the vast mountainous landscape and capturing it on camera is like searching for a needle in a haystack. And then comes a stunning close encounter with the beautiful creatures at a very special place: the breeding station at Wulong. The precious bears live in huge natural enclosures here, breeding and providing specimens to be loaned to a number of zoos all over the world. These particular creatures are only able to serve as ambassadors for their few relatives who still live in the wild since they have become accustomed to captivity, they would not be able to survive by themselves in the rainforests.

programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast

And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. programme.title: SOUTH AFRICA UNCORKED: SOUL, SEA & SAFARI
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger venture beyond the mountains to explore the vibrant soul of South Africa, from the high-adrenaline wild of Kruger National Park to the trailblazing spirit of its first Black-owned winery. The journey begins in Mpumalanga, 'the place where the sun rises,' for an immersive safari experience in Kruger National Park. Accompanied by their daughter, Kynsley, the team experiences nature's masterpiece firsthand, discovering that the 'wild' is as much about preservation as it is about the thrill of discovery. The narrative then shifts to Cape Town, a global cosmopolitan hub where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet. Standing atop the iconic Table Mountain, the hosts reflect on its history as a 'gift to the world' from Nelson Mandela. Deepening their cultural exploration, Kolyn and Lindsey visit the Lesedi Cultural Village to experience the living history of the Zulu people through dance, rhythm, and traditional delicacies. The celebration of South African excellence culminates at Klein Goederust, the first and only 100% Black-owned winery in the Franschhoek Valley. Through a moving conversation with founder Paul Siguqa, the episode highlights a legacy of resilience—transforming generations of farm labor into a future of ownership and Black excellence.

programme.title: ISTANBUL: WHERE EMPIRES MEET THE FUTURE
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the vibrant crossroads of Istanbul, uncovering how ancient empires and modern innovation collide to shape the bridge where western Asia meets eastern Europe. The journey begins with the new direct flight path from Colorado to Istanbul, a gateway to what Turkish Airlines Chairman Ahmet Bolat calls the 'beginning of civilization and culture.' From their base at the Shangri-La Bosphorus—a historic 1920s tobacco warehouse turned luxury landmark—the hosts witness the literal meeting point of Europe and Asia on the Bosphorus Strait. Guided by local experts, the episode explores the architectural force of the Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque, reflecting a city reinvented from the Byzantine and Ottoman eras into a modern republic. The exploration moves beneath the streets to the 2,000-year-old Basilica Cistern before emerging into the sensory experience of the Grand Bazaar, the historic center of global trade. The narrative then shifts to modern medical tourism at EsteNove to investigate Istanbul's role as a global healthcare hub. The journey concludes by blending cultural rituals—from the art of Turkish coffee fortune telling to the 40-layer craftsmanship of baklava—proving that in Istanbul, the past is an active, breathing part of the city's future.

programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger venture beyond the mountains to explore the vibrant soul of South Africa, from the high-adrenaline wild of Kruger National Park to the trailblazing spirit of its first Black-owned winery. The journey begins in Mpumalanga, 'the place where the sun rises,' for an immersive safari experience in Kruger National Park. Accompanied by their daughter, Kynsley, the team experiences nature's masterpiece firsthand, discovering that the 'wild' is as much about preservation as it is about the thrill of discovery. The narrative then shifts to Cape Town, a global cosmopolitan hub where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet. Standing atop the iconic Table Mountain, the hosts reflect on its history as a 'gift to the world' from Nelson Mandela. Deepening their cultural exploration, Kolyn and Lindsey visit the Lesedi Cultural Village to experience the living history of the Zulu people through dance, rhythm, and traditional delicacies. The celebration of South African excellence culminates at Klein Goederust, the first and only 100% Black-owned winery in the Franschhoek Valley. Through a moving conversation with founder Paul Siguqa, the episode highlights a legacy of resilience—transforming generations of farm labor into a future of ownership and Black excellence.

programme.title: ISTANBUL: WHERE EMPIRES MEET THE FUTURE
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the vibrant crossroads of Istanbul, uncovering how ancient empires and modern innovation collide to shape the bridge where western Asia meets eastern Europe. The journey begins with the new direct flight path from Colorado to Istanbul, a gateway to what Turkish Airlines Chairman Ahmet Bolat calls the 'beginning of civilization and culture.' From their base at the Shangri-La Bosphorus—a historic 1920s tobacco warehouse turned luxury landmark—the hosts witness the literal meeting point of Europe and Asia on the Bosphorus Strait. Guided by local experts, the episode explores the architectural force of the Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque, reflecting a city reinvented from the Byzantine and Ottoman eras into a modern republic. The exploration moves beneath the streets to the 2,000-year-old Basilica Cistern before emerging into the sensory experience of the Grand Bazaar, the historic center of global trade. The narrative then shifts to modern medical tourism at EsteNove to investigate Istanbul's role as a global healthcare hub. The journey concludes by blending cultural rituals—from the art of Turkish coffee fortune telling to the 40-layer craftsmanship of baklava—proving that in Istanbul, the past is an active, breathing part of the city's future.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.19

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.20
programme.desc: Do Hyun hesitates to face the truth that Jun Pyo may have been behind Ri Jin's mother's death. Mr. X advises Do Hyun to confront his past for the sake of his future. Meanwhile, one by one, Do Hyun's personalities appear to say goodbye, and Ri Jin finally faces her childhood self.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents the Music & Lyrics Special in celebration of its 4th anniversary! And the last guest of the special trilogy is the super-talented sibling duo AKMU. The two burst into the K-pop scene in 2013 through the competition program K-Pop Star Season 2 and pleasantly surprised the public with their unrefined pure musicality. After being crowned the winners of the season they made their official debut in 2014 with the album PLAY. The elder brother LEE CHANHYUK is known for his exceptional songwriting skills and the younger sister LEE SUHYUN is famous for her crystal clear voice and together they exude a great synergy that makes them one-of-a-kind in the highly competitive K-pop scene. Then in 2015 the duo won the Best Pop Album at the prestigious Korean Music Awards and once again proved that they enjoy both critical acclaim and commercial appeal. They are on the 7th year of their debut and still touch listeners with their creative interpretations of everyday life stories. In this episode AKMU performs ALIEN DINOSAUR How Can I Love The Heartbreak You're The One I Love LAST GOODBYE and GIVE LOVE to showcase the lyrical beauty of their music. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented siblings!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band SORAN! SORAN is one of Korea's top-notch bands composed of vocalist Ko Young-bae bassist Seo Myeon-ho guitarist Lee Tae-wook and drummer Pyeon Yu-il. Unlike what their band name means disturbance in English they offer lively poppy tunes that are relaxing and pleasing to the ears and have gained a steady following in the indie scene since their debut in 2009. Also known for their warm-hearted lyrics and their flawless performances the quartet never fails to get listeners in a good mood. Recently the four dropped their new mini-album Beloved and also held a free online concert titled Perfect Day 0 : Light Steps via YouTube providing a moment of refreshment to everyone around the world. In this episode SORAN performs Be with me the lead single from their new release Don't Lose Weight Ricotta Cheese Salad Confession Of Love and Our Journey. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four outstanding musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the quartet W24! This band burst into the music scene in March 2018 with the song Always Missing You. Composed of vocalist Cheong Ho-won guitarist Kim Yun-soo keyboardist Aaron Park and drummer Kim Jong-gil they compose write and produce all the songs they release and perform. Their name is short for World 24 Hours expressing the band's desire for their music to be heard 24 hours a day around the world. Thanks to their outstanding talents W24 won the Focus Award at the Asia Artist Awards in 2018 and the Best K-Pop Rookie Award at the 2019 Korea Culture Entertainment Grande Prize. Also they participated in The Asian Top Band a project to discover world-class musicians involving 8 Asian countries as the Korean representatives and became the winners. In this episode W24 performs Once Upon A Time Breath Under The Tree and more to show off thier musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: L'Erotomane
programme.desc: L'avvocato Persichetti è un dirigente di una importante società petrolifera. L'uomo è affetto da una nevrosi che gli impedisce di avere rapporti sessuali soddisfacenti tanto con la moglie Ciccia quanto con la giovane e disinibita amante Claretta. Per tentare di guarire, si affiderà alle cure di uno strano psichiatra, ma senza ottenere grossi risultati.

programme.title: Extraconiugale
programme.desc: Film a episodi. Un nuovo modello di doccia scatena le fantasie erotiche di un ingegnere quarantenne. Un timido impiegato, vessato da tutti, decide di vendicarsi quando scopre di avere vinto la lotteria. Un siciliano sposato con una bionda scandinava è convinto di essere finalmente libero dai pregiudizi dei suoi conterranei. Ma il comportamento libero e disinibito di sua moglie scandalizzerà tutti.

programme.title: Il boss
programme.desc: Film Cult di Fernando di Leo. Lanzetta, uno spietato killer, si introduce in un cinema durante la proiezione di un film e massacra la gang del boss Antonino Attardi, colpevole di aver accolto tra le sue file Cocchi, un killer della 'Ndrangheta che vende informazioni alla commissione antimafia, e che mira a diventare membro di Cosa Nostra. Ha così inizio una guerra sanguinaria.

programme.title: Vacanze d'estate
programme.desc: L'industriale Adelmo Turati, diretto a Palinuro in vacanza, incontra l'autostoppista Cardinale, e poi offre un passaggio anche a Olga, una bella ragazza che va a lavorare per l'estate come ragazza alla pari nella villa del giudice Antonelli. Per caso Turati incontra anche l'amica di lunga data Domenica e passa con lei l'estate. Al termine dell'estate e dopo varie vicende, Olga ritorna a Milano.

programme.title: Tutti parlano di Jamie
programme.desc: Nonostante gli ostacoli, il sedicenne Jamie ha il coraggio di seguire incredibilmente il suo insolito sogno in questa suggestiva storia vera trasformata in fenomeno musicale.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Uno anzi due
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia con Maurizio Battista e Claudia Pandolfi. Maurizio è un barista schiacciato dai debiti dopo la morte del padre e decide di ripagarli nascondendo tutto alla moglie e al figlio, che nel frattempo sono impegnati nell'organizzazione del matrimonio di quest'ultimo.

programme.title: La coppia dei campioni
programme.desc: Due dipendenti della stessa multinazionale vincono alla lotteria aziendale un paio di biglietti per la finale della Champions League. Uno milanese, l'altro romano, uno benestante e l'altro nullatenente si conoscono per la prima volta all'imbarco per Praga detestandosi a prima vista.

programme.title: American Hustle
programme.desc: Ambientato nel seducente mondo di uno dei più sbalorditivi scandali che hanno scosso gli Stati Uniti. American Hustle racconta la storia di un brillante impostore che, insieme alla sua scaltra amante, viene obbligato a lavorare per un agente dell'FBI fuori controllo.

programme.title: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: La vera storia di Robinson Crusoe raccontata dal pappagallo Venerdì che sull'isola è diventato il suo migliore amico.

programme.title: Air Buddies
programme.desc: E' arrivata la nuova generazione del famoso franchise di successo Air Bud! Questa volta i protagonisti sono u cinque cuccioli di Air Bud, i Buddies, impegnati in una missione di salvataggio per salvare i loro genitori.

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.sub-title: S2:E1 Alla Ricerca Della Pietra Arcobaleno
programme.desc: S2:E1 Alla Ricerca Della Pietra Arcobaleno - Una nuova orsetta di nome Unione sta per diventare un'Orsetta del Cuore ufficiale quando Allegra rompe accidentalmente la pietra magica necessaria per scegliere il suo colore! Gli orsetti si avventurano in una caverna mistica piena di enigmi e trappole per trovare una nuova pietra.

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.sub-title: S2:E2 La mega avventura di Brontolorso
programme.desc: S2:E2 La mega avventura di Brontolorso - Brontolorso viene colto da un temporale magico che lo fa ingrandire ogni volta che si arrabbia. E ogni volta che cresce, si arrabbia di più! Gli Orsetti del Cuore devono lavorare insieme per trovare una soluzione prima che Brontolorso diventi troppo grande per il loro mondo!

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.sub-title: S2:E3 La Stella dei Mille Desideri
programme.desc: S2:E3 La Stella dei Mille Desideri - Fortunello e Splendente catturano un magico Amico Stellare che concede loro mille desideri! All'inizio è divertente, ma i loro continui desideri causano così tanti problemi che vorrebbero non aver mai iniziato!

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.desc: S2:E4 Il mistero dello spettro - Quando Burbero pensa che il suo nascondiglio sia infestato, chiede aiuto agli orsetti. Gli orsetti non credono ai fantasmi… finché non si ritrovano faccia a faccia con uno! Solo quando Condivisione affronta le sue paure riescono a venire a capo di questa inquietante situazione!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E1 Episodio 1 - Chicky e Bekky suonano uno strumento a corde. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E2 Episodio 2 - Chicky e Poyo saltano più e più volte da un divertente trampolino rosa. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E3 Episodio 3 - Chicky e Bekky scoprono un oggetto divertente con dei quadrati illuminati. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S1:E1 Episodio 1 - Nessuno sa dove sia Chicky. Sappiamo solo che è carino e tanto ingenuo. In questa serie, seguite Chicky, l'uccellino dei cartoni animati, mentre si aggira intorno a un frigorifero, un tostapane, un copertone e tanti altri oggetti!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S1:E2 Episodio 2 - Nessuno sa dove sia Chicky. Sappiamo solo che è carino e tanto ingenuo. In questa serie, seguite Chicky, l'uccellino dei cartoni animati, mentre si aggira intorno a un puzzle, un trenino, un cestino e tanti altri oggetti!

programme.title: Mr. Magorium e la bottega
programme.desc: Molly Mahoney è la goffa e insicura della Bottega delle Meraviglie di Mr. Magorium, il negozio di giocattoli più strano e fantastico del mondo.

programme.title: Genitori in blue jeans
programme.desc: Una serie di personaggi della Roma bene degli anni '50 frequenta la rinomata sartoria di Peppino, un uomo che ha respinto tutte le proposte di matrimonio che gli sono state fatte negli anni. Durante un viaggio a Parigi, Peppino conosce una donna e finalmente se ne innamora, ma proprio dopo aver deciso di sposarla viene a scoprire qualcosa di inaspettato.

programme.title: La bambolona
programme.desc: Un avvocato, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, perde la testa per una ragazza che apparentemente sembra ingenua e sprovveduta. In realtà, la giovane donna sfrutta astutamente la sua bellezza per abbindolare il suo maturo spasimante.

programme.title: I Cuori Infranti
programme.desc: Una divertente commedia che rompe i classici schemi dell'amore. Il film è diviso in due episodi: nel primo, protagonista è una ragazza che riesce a impedire le nozze dell'amato con una rivale. Nel secondo, l'equilibrio di una perfetta famiglia si regge sul ruolo casalingo di lui, e su quello di lei, che procura i soldi tramite attività poco convenzionali.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e la… Malafemmina
programme.desc: Una delle opere più amate del grande Totò che interpreta questo divertente film comico insieme al celebre Peppino De Filippo, il bravissimo Nino Manfredi e la bella Dorian Gray. Totò e Peppino sono due buffi zii di uno studente innamorato di una ballerina. Lei, che non gode di buona fama, si trasferisce a Milano e il ragazzo la segue. Inizia il viaggio degli zii alla volta della Lombardia.

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: Rappresaglia
programme.desc: Roma 23 Marzo 1944. Le truppe tedesche tengono la città sotto il loro controllo. In seguito ad un attentato contro una compagnia delle SS compiuto in via Rasella, il generale Maelzer informa i suoi capi a Berlino che, decisi ad abrogare qualunque soglia di tolleranza, ordinano una veloce rappresaglia, pretendendo l`esecuzione di dieci italiani per ogni tedesco ucciso. Sarà il tenente colonnello Herbert Kapller a gestire l`intervento e a compilare la lista dei sacrificati, nonostante il suo aperto dissenso.

programme.title: I segreti di Brokeback Mountain
programme.desc: Due cowboy, Ennis e Jack, si incontrano su Brokeback Mountain e vivono un amore segreto che segnerà le loro vite per sempre, tra passioni soffocate e il peso delle convenzioni sociali.

programme.title: L'ultimo amore di Casanova
programme.desc: Figlio del XVIII secolo, avventuriero veneziano e amante del piacere, del gioco d'azzardo e dell'avventura: sono questi i tratti che caratterizzano Giacomo Casanova, che - in cerca di nuove emozioni - decide di recarsi a Londra, una città in cui non ha mai messo piede prima. L'unico posto che conosce è quello che gli è stato consigliato dal Cardinale de Bernis, un famoso ed elegante bordello gestito da un francese.

programme.title: Micheal Jackson
programme.sub-title: Chi ha ucciso il re del pop
programme.desc: 25 giugno 2009. La morte di Michael Jackson sconvolge il mondo. Chi ha ucciso il re del pop? Sembra che ognuno abbia una sua teoria, dall'omicidio premeditato al tragico suicidio. Contiene interviste e testimonianze dirette di Jermaine e Tito Jackson, Elizabeth Taylor, Diana Ross e altri. Riprese di provini, video della vita privata, la telefonata al 911 e la cerimonia funebre. Attraverso gli alti e bassi della vita di Michael, questa 'inside story' esamina i fattori e gli eventi che hanno contribuito alla sua morte

programme.title: Hellzapoppin'
programme.desc: Ole e Chick stanno girando un film, ma il regista non è soddisfatto. Così ingaggia un giovane scrittore, che proporrà una storia assurda.

programme.title: L'età giovane
programme.desc: Ahmed ha 13 anni ed è entrato nella spirale dell'integralismo musulmano grazie all'indottrinamento di un imam che, tra le altre cose, gli ripete che la sua insegnante di lingua araba, anch'essa musulmana, è un'apostata. Ahmed che venera un cugino martire dell'Islam, decide allora di procedere autonomamente e di passare all'azione nei suoi confronti.

programme.title: L'UOMO DEI MIEI SOGNI
programme.desc: Niki è una famosa podcaster sulle relazioni tanto da essere contattata per scrivere un libro. Unico problema: tutto il suo podcast è basato su una relazione immaginaria con il ragazzo perfetto. Deve trovare la versione reale, e in fretta

programme.title: Un pizzico di magia
programme.desc: Matt, figlio di un'importante famiglia di streghe, è atteso dal Consiglio delle Streghe per sposare la sua migliore amica Lizzy. Ma quando Matt incontra Sara, una psichiatra, la sua magia lo abbandona e Sara scopre di aver improvvisamente acquisito dei poteri magici.

programme.title: INCUBO FAMILIARE: I SEGRETI DI MAPLE STREET
programme.desc: Tornando a casa tardi in Maple Street, un'adolescente viene messa KO da un intruso. Ma quando si sveglia il giorno dopo e i suoi genitori le dicono che è solo caduta dalle scale, sospetta che le stiano nascondendo un segreto.

programme.title: UN ESTRANEO IN CASA: I SEGRETI DI MAPLE STREET
programme.desc: Dopo la morte della ficcanaso del quartiere, una giovane coppia si trasferisce nella sua casa nella famigerata Maple Street. Ma ben presto, strani eventi li portano a sospettare che la morte della donna nasconda un segreto più profondo.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: La sera di tutti i giorni
programme.desc: La sera di tutti i giorni, il film diretto da Felix Tissi, racconta storie slegate ma unite dal tema della vecchiaia, attraverso i temi dell'amore e della morte.

programme.title: Davanti agli occhi
programme.desc: All'approssimarsi dell'anniversario di una fatale sparatoria in un liceo, Diana è ossessionata dai ricordi della tragedia. Nonostante ciò è riuscita a mettere su una bella famiglia e una vita quasi idilliaca, che però minaccia di essere turbata.

programme.title: Hostile Territory
programme.desc: Di ritorno dalla Guerra Civile, l'ex prigioniero Jack Calgrove scopre che sua moglie è morta e che i suoi figli, presunti orfani, sono su un treno diretto verso un territorio ostile nel profondo West.

programme.title: Life like
programme.desc: James e Sophie si trasferiscono in periferia. Sophie decide di licenziare il personale di servizio. James la convince a sostituirlo con un androide e le sceglie Henry. Tutto è perfetto finchè il cervello di Henry evolve, incominciando a provare emozioni.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Sempre nel mio cuore
programme.desc: Jenna e Charlie hanno trovato l'amore in Irlanda, ma i loro sogni li hanno separati. Cinque anni dopo, si riuniscono e Jenna deve decidere a chi appartiene il suo cuore: tornare a casa o sull'Isola di Smeraldo.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da ricordare
programme.desc: In contrapposizione per via di un progetto di sviluppo, Olivia e Brian sono sorpresi dallo scoprire di essere la damigella d'onore e il testimone dello stesso matrimonio. Dovranno mettere da parte i loro dissapori per salvare le nozze dei loro migliori amici, scoprendo di avere in comune molto più di quanto credevano.

programme.title: Innamorarsi a Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Esausta dal suo lavoro di marketing, Sophie affitta un Airbnb da un padre vedovo e sua figlia per rilassarsi. Tuttavia, la figlia è decisa a far innamorare ancora una volta suo padre, con gli occhi puntati su Sophie.

programme.title: Una pasticceria d'amare
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una fornaia di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando gli sviluppatori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio e costringerla ad andarsene, deve fare tutto il possibile per salvare la sua panetteria, il tutto mentre si destreggia in una storia d'amore in fiore con il fratello del suo cliente.

programme.title: L'anello perfetto
programme.desc: Kate, talentuosa designer di gioielli, crea anelli che celebrano l'amore altrui, ma nella sua vita sentimentale regna l'incertezza. Al matrimonio della sorella ritrova Jaimie, il primo amore mai dimenticato, che le offre una nuova opportunità professionale… e forse qualcosa di più. Divisa tra famiglia, carriera e cuore, Kate scopre che il vero "anello perfetto" non quello che immaginava.

programme.title: La melodia del mio cuore
programme.desc: Una proprietaria di un negozio di tè biologico aiuta una sensazione musicale a scrivere i testi per un nuovo album solista.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere su una rubrica anonima di consigli d'amore. Lì incontra il caporedattore Morgan Cooper. Tra i due scocca subito la scintilla. Sarà proprio Audrey ad essere la nuova protagonista di una delle storie d'amore di cui scrive?

programme.title: Avventure di un uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente strano, un dirigente aziendale diventa completamente invisibile, scappa e viene cacciato da un ufficiale infido della CIA mentre cerca di affrontare la sua nuova realtà.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: Una giovane donna nera scopre che suo padre è stato un donatore di sperma, e se non fosse già abbastanza brutto, è bianco!

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: "The Escort" è un film sull'improbabile legame tra due persone sessualmente consumate, emarginati dalla società.

programme.title: Innamorarsi al Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Stanca della vita frenetica che conduce in città, Sophie Carter si reca in una piccola cittadina di mare per staccare la spina e riflettere su se stessa, alloggiando in un Airbnb gestito dal padre vedovo di una bambina.

programme.title: Amore a quattro mani
programme.desc: Quando a Kacey Cooke, straordinaria food blogger con un seguito impressionante, viene offerta l'opportunità di scrivere il suo libro di cucina, la coglie al volo... L'unico problema è che in realtà non sa cucinare.

programme.title: Amore a Crystal Cove
programme.desc: SKYE si sta preparando ad un altro grande anno della sua attività "Lather and Luxury". Quando il suo amore d'infanzia Gavin arriva in città per aiutarla a migliorare il suo modello di business, inizialmente rifiuta.

programme.title: La fragranza del cuore
programme.desc: Quando Rosalie, americana esperta di profumi, non riesce a ottenere un lavoro in Francia, torna nella sua piccola città natale per aprire un negozio di profumi.

programme.title: Sam
programme.desc: Sam non perde mai l'occasione per incontrare nuove ragazze. Dopo aver abbandonato un addio al celibato, si imbatte in un negoziante che gli offre una bibita misteriosa e il dongiovanni la beve. Sam si risveglia nel corpo di una bellissima donna.

programme.title: Amore on the Road
programme.desc: Quando ABBY riceve un incarico per trasformare un ristorante rustico in un luogo sulla mappa culinaria, è fuori dal suo elemento. Ma mentre ABBY e il proprietario TOM trascorrono del tempo insieme, Abby scopre qualcosa che potrebbe chiamare amore.

programme.title: La squadra di Natale
programme.desc: Allie, un'insegnante d'arte disoccupata, trova lavoro presso la Santa Squad per aiutare un vedovo e le sue figlie a riscoprire la magia del Natale. Mentre lavora ai biscotti di Natale, la sua gentilezza viene ricompensata con un dono inaspettato: l'Amore!

programme.title: Finding Love in San Antonio
programme.desc: A una chef viene offerta la possibilità di lavorare in giro per l'Europa, ma teme di fare la scelta sbagliata per sua figlia, poiché la ragazza è legata alla città San Antonio, Texas. Tuttavia, gli affari del suo ristorante non vanno a gonfie vele.

programme.title: Alex & Emma
programme.desc: Alex è uno scrittore pieno di debiti. Deve scrivere un romanzo entro un mese per avere il denaro con cui saldarli. Contatta la stenografa Emma per aiutarlo nell'impresa. Tra i due si instaura un rapporto che va oltre quello professionale.

programme.title: Il segreto di Clarissa
programme.desc: Dopo la morte della madre Clarissa, Stella si reca in Austria per scoprire il segreto delle sue origini.

programme.title: Nika
programme.desc: Nika è un'adolescente che ama il go-kart. La madre iperprotettiva teme di perdere la figlia in un incidente.

programme.title: Il segreto di Clarissa
programme.desc: Dopo la morte della madre Clarissa, Stella si reca in Austria per scoprire il segreto delle sue origini.

programme.title: Gara d'amore
programme.desc: Sophie è stata condannata al servizio comunitario in un centro per disabili. Qui incontra Georg: un incubo.

programme.title: All That Divides Us
programme.desc: Oltre a prendersi cura coraggiosamente degli affari del marito, Louise si prende cura anche della figlia disabile Julia. Dopo aver coperto Julia dall'aver ucciso accidentalmente il suo fidanzato spacciatore, Louise viene ricattata dal di lui miglior amico Ben, un giovane delinquente che deve ripagare un debito con un pericoloso mafioso per rimanere in vita. Quando viene a sapere la verità, Louise scopre di avere con il giovane in comune molte più cose di quante sospettasse. Stranamente affascinata dal suo ricattatore, non ha idea della spirale di violenza e attaccamento a cui sta per andare incontro.

programme.title: Lola + Jeremy
programme.desc: Jeremy, 27 anni, è un graphic designer e con il suo amico Mathias gestisce l'agenzia Cercasi alibi disperatamente per creare finti alibi tramite fatture, ricevute e scontrini per i fidanzati fedifraghi. Lola, 25 anni, lavora in una fumetteria ed è appassionata di supereroi e dei film di Michel Gondry, in particolare di “Se mi lasci ti cancello” che non si stanca mai di rivedere. Lola e Jeremy decidono di riprendere ogni momento della loro storia d'amore, per creare una sorta di video diario giornaliero da riguardare da lì a dieci anni. Lola, troppo curiosa, non resiste e si mette a guardarli subito da sola. Video dopo video, ne trova uno che non avrebbe dovuto vedere: Jeremy e i suoi amici stanno parlando proprio di lei, prim'ancora di conoscersi, e del progetto di Jeremy di girare un video diario da mostrare al padre in fin di vita in ospedale. Lola, delusa e ferita lascia Jeremy il cui solo scopo sarà, da quel momento, cercare di riconquistarla. Disperato pensa di mettere insieme un gruppo di strampalati supereroi, che rapiscono personaggi famosi. Il riscatto? Lola. E così le vie della periferia parigina si animano di una scalcagnata banda di eroi da fumetto, impegnati a organizzare impossibili e grotteschi rapimenti. Nel film tre piccoli camei, quello del regista Michel Gondry nella parte di se stesso, il batterista Manu Katché, per anni al fianco di Peter Gabriel e il rapper Youssoupha.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: La Regina degli scacchi
programme.desc: Maria Adele, 17 anni, vive per gli scacchi, ma scopre di essere stata adottata e, con l'aiuto di un giornalista, rintraccia la madre biologica. Mentre riaffiora un ricordo d'infanzia che la libera dai tormenti, emerge un'indagine che svela crimini del suo maestro di scacchi, culminati in un tragico epilogo.

programme.title: Come se non ci fosse un domani
programme.desc: Intrappolato in un ciclo di salti temporali, trasportato un anno avanti in una manciata di minuti, Teddy deve affrontare una corsa contro il tempo mentre la sua vita si sgretola intorno a lui.

programme.title: Jagoda: fragole al supermarket
programme.desc: Jagoda ("Fragola"), lavora in un supermarket e sogna di incontrare il grande amore. Contrariamente alla sua collega Ljubica, più attraente, a trent'anni passati Jagoda è sfortunata con gli uomini. Il giorno che l'amica ottiene un appuntamento con il bel vicino di casa di Jagoda, l'ispettore di polizia Nebojsa, la giovane scoppia e sfoga la sua frustrazione su un'anziana signora, buona cliente del negozio, che viene insultata e addirittura buttata fuori dalla stessa Jagoda. Il giorno seguente avviene qualcosa che cambierà la vita di Jagoda: entra nel supermarket un guerriero in tuta mimetica, armato fino ai denti, che prende tutti in ostaggio. Jagoda e Ljubica sono attratte dall'uomo che rifiuta di parlare con i poliziotti normali e vuole negoziare solo con un commando speciale, alla cui guida c'è Nebojsa.

programme.title: Briciole sul mare
programme.desc: Un anonimo pescatore pugliese viene rinvenuto sulle coste siciliane dai fratelli Salvo, promesso sposo di Maria, e Manuele, suo ex compagno. Quando Salvo fa per offrire alla donna un bracciale ritrovato in mare, si scoprirà che il gioiello le era stato donato in precedenza proprio da Manuele. Impossessatosene nuovamente, questi lo aveva poi regalato a Marta, ex amante di Salvo quindi, per vendetta, del fratello. Tornato ancora nelle sue mani, lo aveva infine venduto a un rigattiere. Le cose si complicano quando la polizia recupera il cadavere di una donna che Salvo identifica come la stessa Marta.

programme.title: Lola + Jeremy
programme.desc: Jeremy, 27 anni, è un graphic designer e con il suo amico Mathias gestisce l'agenzia Cercasi alibi disperatamente per creare finti alibi tramite fatture, ricevute e scontrini per i fidanzati fedifraghi.
